definitions.gloss: planting; the act of planting trees and plants
definitions.explanation: The activity of planting trees, shrubs, and other plants, especially for landscaping, urban greening, or environmental purposes.
The trees, shrubs, and plants that have been planted in a particular area, especially as part of landscaping or urban design.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}に{新|あたら}しい{植栽|しょくさい}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: New planting was carried out in the park.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}{沿|ぞ}いの{植栽|しょくさい}{工事|こうじ}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Planting work along the road has begun.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}ごとに{植栽|しょくさい}の{手入|てい}れをしなければならない。
examples.english: The planted vegetation needs to be maintained each season.

examples.japanese: マンションの{植栽|しょくさい}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The landscaping plants at the apartment complex are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}の{周|まわ}りに{植栽|しょくさい}が{施|ほどこ}されている。
examples.english: Landscaping plants have been installed around the parking lot.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{敷地|しきち}{内|ない}の{植栽|しょくさい}が{大|おお}きな{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The landscaping on the property suffered major damage from the typhoon.

notes:
Compound of {植|しょく} (plant) + {栽|さい} (planting/cultivation). Used in both the verbal sense (the act of planting) and the nominal sense (the plants themselves). Common in real estate descriptions, municipal planning documents, and neighborhood notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {植栽|しょくさい}{工事|こうじ}: planting/landscaping work
- {植栽|しょくさい}の{手入|てい}れ: maintenance of planted vegetation
- {植栽|しょくさい}{帯|たい}: planted strip; green belt
- {植栽|しょくさい}{計画|けいかく}: planting plan
- {街路|がいろ}{植栽|しょくさい}: street planting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {植樹|しょくじゅ}: tree planting — specifically planting trees, often ceremonial
- {造園|ぞうえん}: landscape gardening — the broader design and creation of gardens
- {緑化|りょくか}: greening — making an area greener, often as urban policy
- {植木|うえき}: garden tree; potted plant — individual planted trees or potted plants
